claim: Patchline ships a self-checking certificate checker that verifies its own checker against a reference oracle. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the self-checking certificate claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make self-checking-certificate-checker-gate`.
